units.source_text: 四人继续谈论世间种种女子。

en.t: The four of them continued talking about all sorts of women in the world.

units.source_text: 左马头说：“作为世间一般女子看待，固然无甚缺陷；

en.t: The Captain of the Left Division of the Horse Guards said, “If one regards them simply as ordinary women of the world, there is of course little fault to find;

units.source_text: 但倘要选择自己的终身伴侣，则世间女子虽多，实在也不容易选中。

en.t: but if one is choosing a lifelong companion for oneself, then however many women there may be in the world, it is truly not easy to choose the right one.

units.source_text: 就男子而论：辅相朝廷，能为天下柱石而安民治国之人虽然很多，

en.t: As for men, there are many who can assist the court, serve as pillars of the realm, pacify the people, and govern the country,

units.source_text: 但要选择真能称职之人才，实在难乎其难。

en.t: but to choose a person truly equal to the office is exceedingly difficult.

units.source_text: 无论何等贤明之人，一二人总不能执行天下一切政治；

en.t: No matter how wise and capable a person may be, one or two people can never carry out all the affairs of government under heaven;

units.source_text: 必须另有僚属，居上位者由居下位者协助，

en.t: there must also be subordinate officials, with those in higher positions assisted by those below them,

units.source_text: 居下位者服从居上位者，然后可使教化广行，政通人和。

en.t: and those in lower positions obeying those above them; only then can moral instruction spread widely, government run smoothly, and the people live in harmony.

units.source_text: 一个狭小的家庭之中，主妇只有一人。

en.t: In one small household, there is only one mistress.

units.source_text: 如果细考其资格，必须具备的条件甚多。

en.t: If one examines her qualifications closely, the conditions she must possess are very many.

units.source_text: 一般主妇，往往长于此，短于彼；优于此，劣于彼。

en.t: An ordinary mistress is often strong in one respect and weak in another, superior here and lacking there.

units.source_text: 明知其有缺陷而勉强迁就的人，世间很少有吧。

en.t: There are probably very few people in the world who would knowingly accept such flaws and force themselves to make do.

units.source_text: 这并不是像那好色之徒的玩弄女性，想罗致许多女子来比较选择。

en.t: This is not like the behavior of a libertine who toys with women and tries to gather many of them in order to compare and choose among them.

units.source_text: 只因此乃终身大事，会当白头偕老，所以理应郑重选定，

en.t: It is simply because this is a matter for a whole lifetime, one in which husband and wife are meant to grow old together, and so it ought to be decided with great care,

units.source_text: 务求其不须由丈夫费力矫正缺陷，完全如意称心。

en.t: seeking someone whose faults need not be laboriously corrected by her husband and who is entirely pleasing to his wishes and heart.

units.source_text: 因此选择对象，往往难于决定。

en.t: For this reason, deciding whom to choose is often difficult.
